veranderings.voor: siekte van mens tot mens trek
veranderings.na: siekte van mens tot mens versprei
veranderings.rede: 'trek' is not the natural verb for a disease passing between people; 'versprei' is.
Avoids starting two consecutive sentences with 'Mense' and puts the linking word first for better flow.
'sommer' is colloquial; 'vanself' is the standard way to say something arises on its own.

veranderings.blok: Van vrot kos na 'n siek mens
veranderings.rede: Wine sours rather than rots; 'bederf' fits both nouns and matches the word 'bederf' used elsewhere in the lesson.

veranderings.blok: Van vrot kos na 'n siek mens
veranderings.voor: Dit is die verband tussen kieme en siektes
veranderings.na: Dit is die verband tussen kieme en siekte
veranderings.rede: The lesson elsewhere says 'die verband tussen kieme en siekte'; using the same form keeps the phrase consistent.

veranderings.blok: Van vrot kos na 'n siek mens
veranderings.voor: Daardie verband het 'n nuwe manier gegee
veranderings.na: Daardie verband het 'n nuwe manier gebied
veranderings.rede: 'het 'n manier gegee' without a recipient is wooden; 'het 'n manier gebied' is the natural collocation.
'manier van werk' calques 'way of working'; 'metode' is natural and grade-appropriate.

veranderings.voor: Melk of 'n ander vloeistof word warm gemaak
veranderings.na: Wanneer melk of 'n ander vloeistof warm gemaak word
veranderings.rede: A definition should describe the process rather than read as a stand-alone statement; the 'wanneer' form does this without changing the content.

vlae.teks: wat in die 1860's aan hierdie vraag gewerk het
vlae.rede: 'hierdie vraag' has no question to refer back to: the previous block states beliefs but asks nothing, so the reference is vague. Fixing it means naming the question, which needs the intended content.
